text:
Marin (Product): capturing the leftover Qs from today's all-hands on pricing/quotas. Main ask: customers want a clear playbook for burst + credits reconciliation. I'll capture and assign.

Ellen (Finance): short TL;DR: token usage is billed immediately. Credits are applied at invoice time as a balance; we don't hold tokens aside. For bursts, the system still charges tokens, and credits are consumed normally. If a promo credit covers the period, it offsets charges on next invoice.

Ravi (Billing): specific ledger behavior: we tag usage records with `billing_source` (hosted/dedicated) and `credit_bucket` if promo credits are auto-applied. That lets us produce a reconciliation CSV for customers on request.

Zoe (Support): helpful header signals when throttling occurs? Customers asked for richer signals to distinguish burst vs sustained. We currently return `Retry-After`, `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`.

kai_dev (eng): adding ops detail: we're prototyping `Retry-After-Type` values: \"burst\" vs \"quota\" and a `X-Quota-Window` (seconds). Also planning `X-Credit-Preview` (opt-in) which returns a single-line string like `credits=12000;expires=2027-09-01`.

Marin (Product): can we offer customers a predictable "burst buffer" product so marketing launches don't blow through credits unexpectedly?

Ellen (Finance): product idea: short-term burst subscriptions (prepaid blocks) — e.g., buy a 24-hour 2x buffer for a fixed fee. Not in immediate roadmap but Finance thinks it's feasible as an add-on.

Ravi (Billing): interim option: demo passes we already offer (48-72h) and auto-topup. Auto-topup is pre-authorized charge when balance < threshold; useful but customers worry about surprise charges so opt-in only.

Zoe (Support): refund policy question: if platform misrouted traffic and caused credit burn, can we refund?

Ravi (Billing): yes — we audit the event; if there's a platform error we issue credit adjustments. Customers must provide request IDs and time ranges. Typical SLA 3-7 business days for adjustments.

Marin (Product): what about internal test exemptions? Some teams want high-frequency test jobs without draining credits.

kai_dev (eng): we have `x-internal-test: true` header and a per-org "test-exemptions" flag. If enabled we shadow-bill (record usage but set cost=0). Billing Ops must enable per-org after a request and set a daily cap.

Ellen (Finance): controls needed to avoid abuse: written admin approval, daily caps, and monthly audits. Abuse revokes exemption and may trigger recovery billing.

Zoe (Support): can we give customers a dry-run so they can preview how quota enforcement would behave?

Marin (Product): roadmap item: "quota-shadow" EA — logs enforcement events and returns `X-Quota-Shadow: true` in responses but does not block. Good for testing policy changes.

kai_dev (eng): fallback sequence we use on overload: 1) short smoothing window (tier-dependent), 2) model-variant fallback if allowed by routing policy, 3) route to lower-priority pool, 4) 429. Customers can reorder or disable fallback steps via `routing_policy` config.

Ravi (Billing): multi-org customers: pooled billing is opt-in. If enabled we show a single balance and a per-org allocation table. We can export allocation CSVs for finance teams.

Ellen (Finance): question from sales: how do Hosted + Dedicated interact on billing when both are active?

kai_dev (eng): technical behavior: Dedicated usage is charged against reserved billing first. If cross-fallback to Hosted is enabled and used, Hosted consumption is billed to hosted credits. We'll surface both in the console and add an "effective burn" metric.

Ava (CEO): strategic note: no immediate pricing changes planned next quarter. We aim to make economics predictable: clear docs, tooling (preview APIs), and short-term capacity products rather than surprise rate increases.

Marin (Product): action items: 1) draft burst+recon playbook (includes header examples, demo-pass template, refund flow), 2) open EA list for quota-shadow, 3) sample client backoff (respect Retry-After + jitter + backoff cap). I'll post drafts by EOD.

AllHandsBot: slides & transcript uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s/all-hands/2026-07-pricing-recap

Zoe (Support): I'll assemble customer-facing KB snippets and link when Marin posts the draft.

Ravi (Billing): I'll prepare the billing export template and sample reconciliation CSV for Customers who ask.

Marin (Product): thanks everyone 44d
